reading.title: Libra Sun in Fall, Venus Square Pluto
overview: The Sun stands at 27° Libra in its fall, with Venus retrograde at 3° Scorpio in detriment and applying to a conjunction with the Sun. The Moon at 20° Aquarius squares Mercury at 20° Scorpio while opposing Jupiter at 23° Leo. Mars at 13° Leo trines Saturn at 10° Aries retrograde, and outer planets show Neptune at 2° Aries retrograde sextile Pluto at 3° Aquarius, Uranus at 5° Gemini retrograde trine Pluto.

Mundane tradition associates Venus square Pluto with intensified power struggles and value conflicts, Neptune sextile Pluto with gradual shifts in collective beliefs, and Mars trine Saturn with attrition and constrained action. The last new moon at Libra 17° fell in the 11th house for the United States and the 6th for Russia, Ukraine, Israel and Iran, placing emphasis on legislatures and allies or armed forces and public health respectively.
Transits to national angles include Neptune opposing the US MC and Mars conjoining Russia's ASC. No positions or aspects beyond the computed list are used.

nations.reading: Transiting Neptune opposes the Sibly MC within 1.47° while the Sun trines natal Moon at 0.18°. Mars trines the ASC at 0.54°. These sit alongside reporting on US Navy contracts and travel advisories without direct causal linkage claimed.

Transiting Mars conjoins the 1991 ASC at 0.49° and Uranus trines natal Saturn at 0.11°. Jupiter squares natal Venus at 0.04°. The new moon in the 6th house aligns with coverage of armed forces matters.

Transiting Pluto conjoins natal Moon at 0.02° and the ASC at 1.52°. Neptune sextiles natal Moon at 0.71°. Mars sextiles natal Mercury at 0.42°, coinciding with naval monitoring reports near disputed areas.
Transiting Pluto opposes natal Moon at 1.28° and Jupiter sextiles the ASC at 0.23°. Saturn sextiles natal Mercury at 0.31°. These occur with statements on two-state solutions.

reading.lore_and_intel: Venus square Pluto overlaps with reporting on Marseille unrest and Sudan casualty figures; Neptune sextile Pluto overlaps with coverage of Azerbaijan policy shifts and software recovery tools; Uranus trine Pluto overlaps with notes on US-Korea meeting prospects and drone technology exhibits. Mars trine Saturn overlaps with BBC channel closures and Moroccan statements on the two-state solution. No overlap appears with several other listed aspects or with national charts lacking matching intel items.
reading.the_test: Records show Mars afflicted brings war versus Ukraine air-raid alarms no better than chance over 1663 days. Mars afflicted versus Israel alerts and Russian losses also register no better than chance across thousands of days. New and full moons versus earthquakes worldwide likewise show no better than chance over 9750 days.
